title: Wren and the Crown
premise: Jude Hartwell, youngest ledger-keeper of the Meridian Guild, discovers that a century-old book of prophecies has recorded tonight's date — and her own name — as the moment the covenant between the human realm and the Emberlands fails. The guild's impossible trades were never commerce but tithes keeping that covenant alive, and its dying membership means the dragon-fire sustaining both realms is guttering out. Hunted by the Crown's Inquisitors who want the prophecy fulfilled and the Emberlands sealed forever, Jude gathers the guild's scattered survivors — a disgraced knight, a forger of memories, and a half-dragon exile — to reforge the covenant at the First Hearth. She succeeds only by choosing truth over loyalty, exposing the guild's founding lie: the first covenant was built on a stolen dragon egg. The realms are rejoined on honest terms, the last dragon-fire rekindled, and Jude rebuilds the guild not as traders in secrets but as keepers of the record.
about_author: Isandro Dunmore is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing merchant guild records in coastal trading cities before turning to fantasy. They write stories about people who keep accounts — of money, of debts, and of promises.

chapters.title: The Date That Wasn't Tomorrow
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. While balancing the guild's ledgers, Jude finds tonight's date inked into a sealed prophecy book no one has opened in a century — beside her name. Her master, Aldous Vane, burns the page and orders her silence. Emotional beat: quiet dread; the safety of routine shatters.

chapters.title: Tithes and Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Following the ledger's hidden columns, Jude learns the guild's strange trades are tithes feeding a fire beneath the world — and the payments have been failing for years. Inquisitors arrive asking about the prophecy book. Emotional beat: revelation laced with guilt; she has been bookkeeping an apocalypse.

chapters.title: What the Knight Owes
chapters.summary: Ser Maren Kestrel's POV. A disgraced knight who once guarded the guild arrives to collect an old debt, saving Jude from the Inquisitors' raid. She reveals the covenant between realms is breaking and names the scattered survivors Jude must find. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance forged in smoke and ash.

chapters.title: The Forger of Memories
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. In a canal city, they recruit Osk, a memory-forger who erased his own role in the guild's founding sin. He refuses until Jude shows him his own forged past in the ledgers. Emotional beat: uncomfortable truth-telling; trust begins with shared shame.

chapters.title: Ash and Exile
chapters.summary: Ryn's POV. The half-dragon exile Ryn, raised human and rejected by both realms, ambushes the party believing them Crown agents. Jude proves herself by reading the Emberlands' true history aloud from the ledgers. Emotional beat: fury softening into kinship; found family takes root.

chapters.title: The Inquisitor's Mercy
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Hale's POV. Hale, hunting them, is revealed as a former guild child who chose the Crown when the guild abandoned him. He offers Jude pardon for betrayal of her companions. Emotional beat: temptation and refusal; loyalty tested against justice.

chapters.title: The Founding Lie
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Deciphering the original covenant in the First Ledger, Jude discovers it was sealed with a stolen dragon egg — the source of the fire, held hostage for a century. Osk's erased memory confirms it. Emotional beat: horror; every debt traces back to one theft.

chapters.title: Where Loyalty Ends
chapters.summary: Ser Maren's POV. Maren urges Jude to bury the truth and simply renew the old covenant, protecting what remains of the guild. Jude refuses; Maren walks — then returns at dawn, choosing Jude over the institution she served. Emotional beat: the theme crystallizes; truth over loyalty.

chapters.title: The Last Dragon-Fire
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs converging. At the First Hearth, the party confronts Hale and the failing flame. Jude offers the stolen egg back to the Emberlands, renouncing the guild's claim, while Ryn carries the egg into the fire and Maren holds the Inquisitors' line. Emotional beat: sacrifice and climax; the covenant reforged in honesty.

chapters.title: A New Set of Books
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The realms are rejoined; the fire burns steady. Jude reopens the guild with Maren, Osk, and Ryn as its new members, writing the first honest entry in its ledgers. Hale, spared, watches from a distance. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution; family chosen, debts paid, records kept true.
